# Commercial Credit Memorandum: Apex Cold Storage LLC
Application ID: COMM-2026-8814
Date: 04/14/2026
Underwriter: Marcus Vance

## Request Summary
| Parameter | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Requested Facility | Senior Secured Term Loan |
| Loan Amount | $2,400,000 |
| Purpose | Expansion of facility in Des Moines, IA |
| Proposed Term | 120 months |
| Amortization | 240 months |
| Proposed Interest Rate | SOFR + 2.75% |

## Financial Summary (FY 2025)
| Metric | FY 2024 | FY 2025 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Gross Revenue | $8,450,000 | $9,200,000 |
| Operating Expenses | $6,100,000 | $6,550,000 |
| Net Operating Income | $2,350,000 | $2,650,000 |
| Annual Debt Service (Existing) | $620,000 | $620,000 |
| Proposed New Debt Service | $0 | $210,000 |
| Total Combined Debt Service | $620,000 | $830,000 |
| Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR) | 3.79x | 3.19x |

## Collateral & Guarantees
| Asset Description | Appraised Value | Prior Liens | Net Equity |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cold Storage Facility (Des Moines) | $4,500,000 | $1,200,000 | $3,300,000 |
| New Refrigeration Equipment | $1,100,000 | $0 | $1,100,000 |
| Total Collateral Base | $5,600,000 | $1,200,000 | $4,400,000 |

## Underwriting Analysis
The borrower demonstrates robust operating performance with FY 2025 Net Operating Income reaching $2,650,000. Post-issuance, the combined annual debt service increases to $830,000, leaving a strong Debt Service Coverage Ratio of 3.19x, which comfortably exceeds our credit policy benchmark of 1.25x.

The proposed collateral package provides sufficient security. However, the loan-to-value calculation requires attention: the requested loan of $2,400,000 against the total collateral base of $5,600,000 yields an unadjusted LTV of 62.5%.

## Recommendation & Approval Conditions
- Primary collateral: First mortgage on Des Moines real estate and first perfected UCC-1 on new refrigeration equipment.
- Personal guaranty required from majority owner Harlan Finch with standard recourse.
- Minimum global DSCR covenant of 1.25x tested annually on December 31.
- Borrower must maintain a working capital balance of at least $500,000.

errors.quote: requested loan of $2,400,000 against the total collateral base of $5,600,000 yields an unadjusted LTV of 62.5%
errors.explanation: The loan-to-value (LTV) calculation is factually incorrect. $2,400,000 divided by $5,600,000 equals 42.86% (or ~42.9%), not 62.5%.
errors.fix: requested loan of $2,400,000 against the total collateral base of $5,600,000 yields an unadjusted LTV of 42.9%

errors.quote: Personal guaranty required from majority owner Harlan Finch with standard recourse.
errors.explanation: A credit memorandum covenant requiring a personal guaranty must specify the guarantor's ownership percentage (or specific guarantee amount/percentage), which is missing here.
errors.fix: Personal guaranty required from 100% majority owner Harlan Finch with standard recourse.
